description: Record a standing decision: a ruling plus the situation it applies to. `trigger` is required and is phrased the way a FUTURE question would be asked ("Use when choosing a full-text index strategy"), because that is what search matches against. To replace an earlier decision, pass its id in `supersedes`; the old row is kept and marked superseded.

evidence.description: episode ids (or "episode:<id>" handles) this decision rests on (optional for decisions). Cite an episode you relied on; get ids from memory_search (layer 'episode') hits.

scope.description: What this does NOT apply to.

status.description: Default current. provisional = agreed, not yet proven.

trigger.description: When this applies, in the vocabulary of a future query.

name: memory_decision
